name: AI Research
description: For researchers and applied ML engineers tracking new papers, lab releases and the practitioner conversation around them. Primary arXiv feeds sit next to the lab blogs that announce the work.

themes.label: Papers & Preprints
themes.hint: A specific piece of published research with authors and a method: architectures, training and optimisation techniques, theory, and empirical studies. Usually an arXiv posting or a conference paper rather than a product announcement.

themes.label: Model & Dataset Releases
themes.hint: Artifacts made available to use: model weights and checkpoints, open datasets, tokenizers, libraries and inference stacks, with licence and access terms. Something is downloadable or callable as a result.

themes.label: Evaluation & Benchmarks
themes.hint: Measuring systems rather than building them: new benchmarks and leaderboards, contamination and reproducibility disputes, red teaming results, human preference studies and claims that a reported score does not hold up.

themes.label: Safety & Alignment
themes.hint: Controlling model behaviour: interpretability, RLHF and preference optimisation, jailbreaks and prompt injection, deception and sandbagging findings, model cards, system prompts and refusal behaviour, and lab safety frameworks.

themes.label: Training Infrastructure
themes.hint: What it takes to run the work: GPU and TPU clusters, distributed training and parallelism, quantisation and serving efficiency, kernels and compilers, and the cost or energy accounting of a training run.

themes.label: Applied AI
themes.hint: AI put to work in a domain: code generation, biology and drug discovery, robotics and embodied agents, healthcare, science acceleration, and deployment reports from production systems.

themes.label: Community & Governance
themes.hint: The field talking about itself: funding, hiring and lab reorganisations, conference and peer review controversy, open versus closed weights debate, compute export rules and AI regulation affecting researchers.

config.query: (Anthropic OR OpenAI OR DeepMind) research when:2d
